Chapter 650: Chapter 3: Twenty Years (5000 words, please subscribe)

“””

“Three You Time Index?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being was somewhat startled; as the ultimate of the Xia You evolutionary path, he knew all too well what the Three You Time Index signified.

Only by comprehending the Rule of Time to a very high degree could one hope to come into contact with the Three You Time Index.

In that respect, seeing this time index listed in the Eleventh Stage Volume of the Xia You Evolution Path said it all.

Most who had just reached the rank of Eleventh-Rank Evolver had not comprehended this kind of time index, and yet Lin Yuan, a Ninth-Rank life form, had?

...

“Are you sure it is the Three You Time Index?” Xia Qin Supreme Being asked Lin Yuan.

In truth, Xia Qin Supreme Being already had an answer in his mind—how could a Supreme Being possibly forget the words just spoken?

“It is the Three You Time Index,” Lin Yuan nodded.

The nine Supreme Beings of Human Civilization were absolutely trustworthy, save for a few secrets, such as the Door to the Myriad Realms, the Mysterious Gourd, the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, and others—there was no need to hide anything else.

Especially with comprehension of the Rule of Time, since it was not about plundering, the more Lin Yuan revealed, the greater the esteem he would receive.

Most importantly, how could he gain guidance from a Supreme Being if he did not directly voice his confusion?

“The Three You Time Index is a certain measure of the flow rate of time…” Xia Qin Supreme Being gazed at Lin Yuan, thought for a moment, and still began to explain.

Upon hearing this, a multitude of realizations flooded Lin Yuan’s mind, and countless questions regarding the Rule of Time were answered.

[Your comprehension is heaven-defying; by listening to the essence of the Rule of Time, your understanding of the 1,823rd type of time model has deepened…]

…

[Your comprehension is heaven-defying; by listening to the essence of the Rule of Time, your understanding of the 1,823rd time model has deepened…]

…

[Your comprehension is heaven-defying; by listening to the essence of the Rule of Time, you have grasped the 1,823rd type of time model…]

…

Merely by listening for less than half an hour, Lin Yuan had deciphered all the time models that had confounded him, and his understanding of the Rule of Time had reached a whole new level.

“Time, this is time.”

Lin Yuan’s mind was invigorated; Xia Qin Supreme Being’s explanation of the Three You Time Index had shown him another side of time, not just confined to this time index itself.

This was to infer other things from one fact, to learn by analogy!

From his throne, Xia Qin Supreme Being saw that Lin Yuan was silent and waited for a while before asking, “How is it? Do you understand? Let me explain it to you again.”

Normally, even Eleventh-Rank Evolvers are immensely confused when they first encounter the concept of the Three You Time Index, and even if they received his personal explanation, they would remain puzzled for some time.

One must constantly verify against the time rules of the Main Universe to gradually understand.

“Thank you, Supreme Being, I understand now,” Lin Yuan immediately said.

At this moment, he had fully grasped the Three You Time Index, and all 1,823 time models had been comprehended.

For the time being, Lin Yuan would not face any confusion or bottlenecks regarding the Rule of Time.

“Hmm?”

“You already understand?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being fell silent once more.

Just one explanation, and you understand?

Xia Qin Supreme Being carefully observed Lin Yuan, somewhat surprised and unsettled.

“Yes,” Lin Yuan raised his right hand, instantly constructing the 1,823rd type of time model, with strands of time weaving around his fingertips.

Whether it was space models or time models, they were all unveiled by the pioneer scholars of Human Civilization according to their own understanding, materializing the essence of space and time in a form comprehensible to the masses.

“Hmm…” Xia Qin Supreme Being glanced at the time model Lin Yuan had constructed and was clear that the other party truly understood.

Without understanding, it was impossible to construct such a time model.

Even imitating wouldn’t work.

In the comprehension of rules, understanding is understanding, not understanding is not understanding.

“Lin Yuan…” Xia Qin Supreme Being looked at Lin Yuan with mixed feelings, “You really surprise me.”

He had been duly informed of everything that happened in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm; he initially thought Lin Yuan had a high understanding of the essence of space, but who would have thought that his level of comprehension in the Rule of Time would also be so profound?

To conceive the 1,823rd time model? When had he himself conceived this time model? It was after he stepped into the Tenth Rank.

And Lin Yuan had done so at the Ninth Rank?

Wasn’t this aptitude for the Rule of Time even surpassing that of other Supreme Beings of the same period?

Had Lin Yuan been a special life form, it would have been a different story; some special life forms with time attributes find it easy to comprehend the Rule of Time.

Just like Starry Sky Wanderer Kun comprehends Space Rules.

But Lin Yuan wasn’t just not a special life form; he didn’t even have the bloodline of one.

“It’s luck, just happened to have some smooth comprehensions recently,” Lin Yuan modestly stated.

“Smooth comprehensions?” Xia Qin Supreme Being felt there was something off about that phrase.

“The Rule of Time is very important,” Xia Qin Supreme Being pondered for a while before saying, “The earlier you thoroughly understand the Rule of Time, the better it is for the future.”

“If you can grasp all the models of the Rule of Time before stepping into the Tenth Rank, come find me again,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said.

So far, Human Civilization has constructed 2,173 types of time models.

Grasping all the time models only proves that one’s comprehension of the Rule of Time has reached a certain height; there’s still a distance from thoroughly comprehending the Rule of Time.

To cover this distance, the Evolver must rely on their own sensations and comprehensions.

Of course, certain external forces also have a propelling effect in this area.

“””
